_comment: tools/bm_vault_provenance.py entered the inventory on 2026-08-31 (WBS row VB3-07, enterprise evidence locators: query_id, document_span, capture): three sys.stderr.write sites, all operator-facing and none carrying user or model text. No user or model prose is written, only opaque entity ids already validated as vault note ids, a rule-version string the caller typed on the command line, and ISO dates; reviewed site by site, not accepted on the scanner's count alone. bm_vault_jbench.py landed at 4 on 2026-08-31 (VB2-03, the Japanese-first retrieval benchmark runner): os.makedirs and a write-mode open for its own temp-directory user-dictionary.json (installed once per run so dictionary_dependent cases exercise the analyzer seam real dictionary path, never a tracked file), the json.dump call writing through that same handle, and shutil.rmtree cleaning up its own temp vault directory afterward. No user or model text reaches any of them: the dictionary terms come from the benchmark fixture file and the vault directory is deleted, never read back by anything else.
